title: Avoid patchwork shading
alt_text: A patchy fruit with many small competing marks is compared with a fruit grouped into broad light, middle, and dark regions and a separate cast shadow.
caption: Name the big value groups before working on small surface marks.

provenance.license_or_attribution: Original course diagram; no source-book illustration was copied.

review_notes: The cast shadow is a separate mass offset rightward from the light source. Labels accompany color coding.
